name: GPO and SYSVOL status history
description: Workspace-wide history per Environment (domain) using the execution bin interval: maximum observed counts/sizes, with derived percentages. Selected systems route workspaces only. Gaps/missing metrics are not healthy zeros; colors are illustrative, not alert rules.
kql:
SysvolStats_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| extend Environment = tostring(Environment)
| summarize LargeGPOs = max(todouble(LargeGPOs)), UnlinkedGPOs = max(todouble(UnlinkedGPOs)), LargeUnlinkedGPOs = max(todouble(LargeUnlinkedGPOs)), OrphanedGPOFolders = max(todouble(OrphanedGPOFolders)), GPODiscSizeBytes = max(todouble(GPODiscSize)), LargeGPODiscBytes = max(todouble(LargeGPODiscSize)) by Environment, Timestamp = bin(TimeGenerated, _BinSize)
| extend GPODiscSizeGiB = GPODiscSizeBytes / 1073741824.0, LargeGPODiscGiB = LargeGPODiscBytes / 1073741824.0, LargePct = iff(GPODiscSizeBytes > 0, 100.0 * LargeGPODiscBytes / GPODiscSizeBytes, real(null)), LargeUnlinkedPctOfUnlinked = iff(UnlinkedGPOs > 0, 100.0 * LargeUnlinkedGPOs / UnlinkedGPOs, real(null))
| extend Metrics = bag_pack('LargeGPOs', LargeGPOs, 'UnlinkedGPOs', UnlinkedGPOs, 'LargeUnlinkedGPOs', LargeUnlinkedGPOs, 'OrphanedGPOFolders', OrphanedGPOFolders, 'GPODiscSizeGiB', GPODiscSizeGiB, 'LargeGPODiscGiB', LargeGPODiscGiB, 'LargePct', LargePct, 'LargeUnlinkedPctOfUnlinked', LargeUnlinkedPctOfUnlinked)
| mv-expand Dimension = bag_keys(Metrics) to typeof(string)
| extend Value = todouble(Metrics[Dimension])
| where isnotnull(Value)
| project Timestamp, Series = iff(isempty(Environment), 'Unknown environment', Environment), Dimension, Value
| order by Timestamp asc
